title: Polish: gate boss HP HUD visibility on encounter start (don't show the Warden bar during traversal)
description: LOW from the TASK-029 review. In sector_01 the reused BossHUD (scripts/ui/boss_hud.gd) polls and renders the Warden HP bar + 'THE WARDEN' label every frame from level start, so the boss bar is visible during the whole traversal before the player reaches the boss room (the dormant Warden is on-screen behind BossWallLeft). Functionally fine, but cosmetically the bar shows full HP across the sector run. Gate HUD visibility on Sector01.encounter_started (the signal already exists as the hook) so the boss bar/label only appear once the encounter triggers. Also (secondary nit) the VictoryLabel 'SECTOR CLEAR' is driven by the Warden's defeated signal in boss_hud.gd rather than Sector01.sector_victory — both fire from the same 0-HP event so it's correct in practice, but consider coupling the sector-victory UI to the sector_victory state for clarity. Non-urgent polish; M1 is functionally complete.
acceptance_criteria: The Warden boss HP bar + label are hidden during sector_01 traversal and become visible when Sector01.encounter_started fires (or the player reaches the boss room).
Arena.tscn boss HUD behavior is unchanged (the arena boss is awake from the start, so its HUD should still show as before).
Full GUT suite stays green exit 0 (run multiple times, flake-aware), gdlint clean, no new stderr noise.
